decision: Source-dependent NO-GO for a new native EMC numerical metabolic/function stage.
independent_reason: The newly found NMR measurement concept is real, but the sole generic chondrosarcoma lacks an actual EMC/specimen bridge and accepted public processed input. The separate protein cohort is UPS/LMS/DDLPS. Treating the NMR cohort as enzyme activity, or transferring protein loss from the separate cohort to the unnamed specimen, would create an unsupported functional claim.
source_validity: Aqueous extract NMR with total-spectral-area normalization measures steady-state relative metabolite signals, not direct complex-II turnover, flux, respiration or drug response. A purely descriptive native metabolic comparison could still be worthwhile if actual diagnosis, input and controls were authenticated; lack of an enzyme assay does not intrinsically invalidate all metabolite questions.
coverage: 102 FFPE specimens from101 patients are distinct from the15 fresh tumors from16 surgical patients. All10 named tumor categories in the fresh cohort are retained; the one generic chondrosarcoma is unknown, notzeroEMC. Individual normal counts, tumor-normal and FFPE/NMR/protein crosswalks remain pending. Access403 and HTML instead of the declared document do not prove all public data absent.
strongest_alternatives: Different tissue composition, extraction/normalization and specimen handling
Different cohorts/donors behind the protein and metabolite claims
Histotype/therapy/site effects and compositional spectral normalization
specific_reopening: A genuine publicly accessible primary-linked diagnosis/specimen and processed-measurement manifest that resolves the generic chondrosarcoma and all relevant tumor/normal/control conditions. Only then freeze a consequential new steady-state phenotype question beyond published UPS context; retain enzyme/flux interpretations outside the measured assay.
review_scope: One independent before-values source/prior-art/usefulness challenge of the exact frozen compact gate. No new primary retrieval, outcome access, cutoff, statistic, hypothesis or whole-paper review.
no_universal_veto: A limited empirical RNA, protein, imaging or metabolite comparison may be useful without universal protein validation or same-donor pairing. Required controls depend on the actual estimand.
promotion: NO. Suitable public evidence and identity/control/assay gaps remain pending; source eligibility itself is not a publication-worthy finding.
campaign: Goal unmet; search not exhausted; existing GPNMB candidate remains held and TMEM266 shelved.
